citation: User-supplied integrated meta-analysis combining bulk RNA-seq DEGs from GSE164471 (Tumasian 2021), GSE111016 (Pillon 2019), and GTEx v11 with cell-type-resolved labels.
modality: integrated bulk-RNA-seq meta-analysis projected onto cell-type categories
design: per-cell-type pseudobulk-style DEG with balanced 2000-cells-per-(cell_class x age_group) design (see cell_counts_per_age_group.csv)
comparison: old vs young per cell type
differential_method: Wilcoxon for muscle cell types (score column = Wilcoxon stat); DESeq2 for fibroblast (cell type label `fibroblast_deseq2`)
table_columns: gene, log2fc, pval, padj, direction (up|down), cell_type, score

consensus_thresholds.rationale: File is pre-filtered to top ~200 genes per cell type with strong signal; default thresholds apply

role_in_consensus: PRIMARY bulk-equivalent source. Replaces the separate GSE164471/GSE111016/GTEx slots since this file is described as integrating those three studies with cell-type resolution. Counts as ONE source in the >=2-source consensus voting (not three).
supersedes: GSE164471_tumasian_2021/deg_table.tsv (re-derived locally; subsumed by this integrated file)
notes: Direction convention: `up` = upregulated in aged (P1); `down` = upregulated in young (P2). Cell-type labels match the v1 atlas per_cell_type taxonomy.
